Bash(gh release create v2.1.0 "app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk" --title "v2.1.0" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## What''s New

### Player
- **Audio & Subtitle Track Picker** — D-pad navigable slide-in panel to switch audio languages and subtitles
- **D-pad Seek Fix** — Left/Right seeks on progress bar, navigates between action buttons at the bottom
- **Seek Feedback** — On-screen "+10s" / "-10s" with cumulative display for rapid taps
- **Custom Cinematic Controls Bar** — Bottom-anchored controls with gold theme, quality badge, EPG info
- **Channel Banner** — Pre-roll banner on live TV with current + next program info
- **Watch Next Suggestions** — AI-recommended movies at end of playback
- **Series Complete Overlay** — Replay/Exit options when a series finishes

### Home Screen
- **Trending Series Row** — Top 20 most recently updated series with poster cards
- **For You — Live Now** — Personalized channel recommendations based on watch history
- **Smart EPG Gap Filler** — Infers program info when real EPG data is missing

### Other
- **Content Info Overlay** — Long-press on any poster for metadata, plot, and quick actions
- **Login Error Handling** — Friendly messages for wrong password \(HTTP 512\), server errors, timeouts
- **App Name** — Updated to "Ooustream IPTV"
EOF
\)")

Bash(gh release create v2.1.1 "app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk" --title "v2.1.1 — OTA Update & Speed Test Fix" --notes "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## v2.1.1 — Hotfix

### Fixes
- **OTA Update System** — Check for Updates now properly displays update availability and download button. Previous versions had a silent UI bug where the update screen loaded but couldn''t show results.
- **Speed Test** — Accurate download speed measurement using full channel data instead of a tiny payload that gave misleadingly low results.

### Important
This is the **last version that needs manual installation**. Once customers are on v2.1.1, all future updates can be installed directly from **Settings → Check for Updates**.

### Install
Download `app-release.apk` below and sideload via ADB:
```
adb install -r app-release.apk
```
EOF
\)")
